description: Header file defining clock configuration structures, macros, and function prototypes for Nuvoton NPCX series SoC clock control within Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: npxc_clock_capture_low_freq_timer
methods.description: Notify clock driver to backup low-frequency timer counter before deep idle.

methods.name: npxc_clock_compensate_system_timer
methods.description: Notify clock driver to compensate system timer after leaving deep idle.

methods.name: npxc_clock_get_sleep_ticks
methods.description: Retrieve system sleep/deep sleep ticks count.

methods.name: npxc_clock_control_turn_on_system_sleep
methods.description: Configure system sleep mode, specifying deep sleep and instant wake-up.
